{{Quote|Bark mites! Fascinating little creatures, but they absolutely destroy the greenery!|[[Risha Sinan]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BMS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Bark Mite Samples|Rori}}</ref>}}
'''Bark mites''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They ate bark, and made large hives in [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and caves.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Swgpets-bark_mite.png|thumb|left|200px|A bark mite]]
Bark mites possessed eight limbs in total; they walked on six legs, and had two grasping arms with pincers.<ref name="SWG" /> These beasts were herbivorous insects. They were usually docile but they could become aggressive when protecting their lair.<ref name="SWG:GBMC" />

Races and subspecies included the '''bloodseeker mite''', the '''forest mite''' and the '''wood mite'''.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|It is the great many-legged warrior of the bark mites, fierce and relentless. We call it the Chirping Death. Hrnnh -- maybe that is not such a good name. Not fearsome. The bloodseeker is fearsome.|[[Jorak]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Fightmaster Jorak|Endor}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a colony of giants bark mites lived in a [[Giant Bark Mite Cave|cave]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. The creatures had discovered that the cave was damp and warm, making it a perfect nursery for their brood.<ref name="SWG:GBMC" /> The scientist [[Risha Sinan]] discovered the cave after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:BMS" />

[[File:Forest_mite.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A forest mite on Rori.]]
After the Battle of Yavin, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maldien]] conducted illegal and highly dangerous [[bioengineering]] experiments in a [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to create very aggressive and intelligent creatures. This included engineered bark mites.<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Clear Out the Zoo|Corellia}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Sloan Rusper]] noticed that something in the water of Rori turned wild animals, including forest mites, into dangerous marauding beasts. He thus tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill a deadly forest mite guardian that threatened the [[Restuss Arts Jubilee]].<ref name="SWG:LSR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Lord Sloan Rusper|Rori}}</ref> The same year, the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauder]] fightmaster [[Jorak]] ordered a spacer to kill a bloodseeker mite which was attacking the livestock of the Marauders on Endor.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bark mites appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
